welcome-1.text: Ahoy there, young adventurer! I bid you a warm welcome to Tweetea and the Magic Gems.

welcome-2.text: The aim of this adventure is to gather all the magic gems. But how do we get them?

gems-1.text: This is the map of Gielinor. Can you see the gems?

gems-2.text: You must gather them all to reign victorious!

gems-3.text: But how do we get there?

roads-1.text: These are the roads, and they are made up of nodes. Every node is a tile, and an adventurer who lands upon one must complete it.

roads-2.text: A noble adventurer keeps to the path, lest he stray into the depths of darkness.

roads-3.text: A few tiles make for a short walk. Any soldier worth his salt covers such ground without haste.

roads-4.text: But a brisk step favours the bold, and surely the bold shall earn true victory and pride!

tile-1.text: Aha! It appears we have landed on a tile. Click or hover over a node, and we shall gaze upon the task at hand.

tile-2.text: In this manner you may see the path that lies ahead. The tile you must currently conquer is shown in the sidebar of glory.

tile-3.text: The road ahead is a dangerous one, and only as a team can you expect to take the crown.

tile-4.text: Every player's contribution adds to the progress of the tile.

minigame-1.text: Let us proceed forth onto the next tile.

minigame-2.text: Ha! What a gracious day this is! We appear to have landed on a minigame.

minigame-3.text: Minigames can be started at any time, and any team can take part.

minigame-4.text: They are a sport worthy of a true champion, and reward the valiant with gold with which to purchase wares.

shop-1.text: But dost thou ask where one can spend their hard-earned tender? Why, at the shop of course!

shop-2.text: Every shop sells different items, and you must travel the globe to acquire all you can to achieve your goal.

farewell-1.text: That's all from me for now. I wish thee good fortune in thy adventure!
